note: Limits started as the baseline x 1.5 (memory x 1.3), rounded up; the baseline is the highest median of the CI runs of the fresh-machine job on ubuntu-latest (Nov 12, 2026). Memory was tightened by hand on Nov 26 (perf-idle-memory, #1265): 132 MB, a few MB over the 127.9 MB that CI measured once Find a tool's registry copy stopped loading at startup, so the next jump fails CI. after_search_rss_mb (Find a tool synced a fake 75,000-entry registry, A2) is held to about 20 MB over idle: 150 MB. Measures in `blocking` fail the CI step (exit 1); the rest only WARN (browser_launch_s until Kit's #1266 fixes the 8 s Chrome stall). Rewrite with `perf_budget.py --update-baseline` on purpose.

baseline_from.runs: fresh-machine on 1b2052c4, aff15db5, ff7279c5, 5fbde03f, 926435e2 (browser: the last two); 5 runs each, memory in 3

release.note: PROVISIONAL until 3 runs on main (perf-release-budget, 0.9.56): limits = median of 3 perf-release CI samples x 1.15, rounded up (run 45865640764, #1284 samples 1-3, one runner each; perf_budget.py --set-release-limits). Re-set from 3 main runs once the job has run there. Judged by the perf-release job (cargo build --release), not by fresh-machine. browser_launch_s is warn-only.
